outline: The aim of this course is to help students develop the ability for conducting academic research through the study of practical problems and paper readings. The contents of this course include defining research problems and hypothesis, research design, literature review, methodology, research ethics, case studies, and writing up.
schedule:
Week 1 Introduction
week 2 Literature review
week 3-4 Instructions for reading a scientific paper effectively
week 5-6 Reference management software
week 7-8 Writing format styles
week 9-10 Midterm presentation
week 11-12 Research frameworks
week 13-14 Instructions for writing a scientific paper effectively
week 15-16 Academic phrases for writing results & discussion Sections
week 17-18 Final presentation
consultation: The lecturer can be reached at whchen@ntut.edu.tw
remarks:
●上課方式：遠距上課



●評量方式：Midterm and final presentations will be scheduled online if the Level 2 COVID alert remains.
